parameters.query: SELECT (b.binding_key IS NOT NULL) AS found, b.context_id, b.enabled, (b.halted_at IS NOT NULL) AS halted, r.status AS context_status, r.db_schema FROM (SELECT $1::text AS k) AS q LEFT JOIN jarvis_ops.source_binding b ON b.binding_key = q.k LEFT JOIN jarvis_ops.context_registry r ON r.context_id = b.context_id
